episodes.title: Lisa-Codename Yvette
episodes.summary: Brussels 1941: " Lifeline", the evasion organisation run by a young Belgian woman known as Yvette, is successful in helping allied airmen shot down in Europe. London decides to send an RAF officer to co-ordinate activities, but the Gestapo are also sending Sturmbahnfuhrer Kessler

episodes.title: Sergeant on the Run
episodes.summary: A group of evaders is caught and shot except for the nervous Sergeant Walker who falls into Kessler's hands. Rather than talk he attempts suicide, but he does not succeed

episodes.title: Radishes with Butter
episodes.summary: Curtis brings money from England for the evasion lines and becomes involved with a Jewish family ... as well as with Yvette.

episodes.title: Child's Play
episodes.summary: An unpublished magazine article written by a repatriated evader comes into Brandt's hands. Its details are disguised but Brandt believes he can deduce the escape route across the Pyrenees.

episodes.title: Second Chance
episodes.summary: An evader, found by a bargee, does not want to be repatriated. Comfortable Swiss internment is not Lifeline's purpose. The bargee is not all he seems ... nor is Curtis's offer of help.

episodes.title: Growing Up
episodes.summary: More than ' Lifeline ' is put at risk by a young Belgian boy's discovery of a wounded airman.

episodes.title: Lost Sheep
episodes.summary: A new type of aircraft, a 'Mosquito', is shot down with highly secret radar equipment on board. The navigator survives and is sheltered by an expatriate Englishman who quickly finds himself forced to decide where his loyalties lie

episodes.title: Guilt
episodes.summary: Curtis decides to check out a betrayal, but ' Lifeline' does not trust him.

episodes.title: Too Near Home
episodes.summary: In France, Yvette is caught in a police raid and imprisoned. In Brussels her uncle, Gaston, is picked up by the Gestapo. 'Lifeline ' is without their leader and faced with collapse.

episodes.title: Identity in Doubt
episodes.summary: An airman fails to convince ' Lifeline ' of his identity. In desperation he seizes Natalie as hostage.

episodes.title: A Question of Loyalty
episodes.summary: The Germans succeed in infiltrating ' Lifeline ' with a Gestapo man posing as an RAF evader. Monique has fallen out with Albert and the infiltrator is attractive

episodes.title: Hymn to Freedom
episodes.summary: Curtis persuades Yvette to smuggle a Belgian pro-Nazi minister to England as a propaganda coup for the Allies. But Kessler has other ideas.

episodes.title: Bait
episodes.summary: A widowed English woman becomes involved with an evader and appeals to an old friend - Brandt - for help. But the airman is a German plant and ' Lifeline' is at risk.

episodes.title: Good Friday
episodes.summary: Dom Pierre shelters an RAF evader in his monastery. The monks' loyalties are divided between patriotism and their faith.

episodes.title: Suspicions
episodes.summary: Curtis is under suspicion. Kessler and Brandt trace him to the Cafe Candide.

episodes.title: Be the First Kid on Your Block to Rule the World
episodes.summary: The Gestapo put a security ring around Brussels to trap Curtis. He has one slim chance of escaping.

episodes.title: The Hostage
episodes.summary: A senior army officer with detailed knowledge of a Middle East offensive is forced to bail out over occupied territory. ' Lifeline ' is ordered to prevent his interrogation at any cost.

episodes.title: Russian Roulette
episodes.summary: ' What do you mean they're different from the other evaders? ' ' They're Russians. They've just walked across Germany.'

episodes.title: Lucky Piece
episodes.summary: ' Lifeline ' is landed with a very special agent and a wounded Polish engineer ... from Peenemunde, where Hitler's secret weapon is very much a reality .. , and Kessler is hot on their trail.

episodes.title: Trapped
episodes.summary: The place is the French side of the border-Monique is shot. The authorities will contact her next-of-kin, but her papers are false.

episodes.title: Not According to Plan
episodes.summary: ' Suppose the Germans get there first ... will this man be able to cope?' ' I doubt it . . . he's blind.'

episodes.title: Scorpion
episodes.summary: '... there are 19 evaders in our Brussels safe houses. Which one is the German ... ? We can't kill them all! '

episodes.title: Weekend
episodes.summary: Two aggressive Americans intend to do it their own way. They have hostages. One of them is Chief of Gestapo in Brussels ... and they don't know it.

episodes.title: The Big One
episodes.summary: Target Berlin ... the Big One. It means heavy losses ... and short shrift to any flying man shot down and picked up by Germans.

episodes.title: Little Old Lady
episodes.summary: 'I can drive a railway engine. Dressing-up as an old woman is just not on!'

episodes.title: Guests at God's Table
episodes.summary: The Feast of St Nicholas brings a new problem for Lifeline '. This time they have to buy their evader ... but the goods are damaged, and the sellers are children.

episodes.title: A Matter of Life and Death
episodes.summary: Max's allegiance to the Communist cause means another death within 'Lifeline', but Max has marked his own card.

episodes.title: Prisoner of War
episodes.summary: ' Lifeline ' pick up a wounded air ace .. but he is Luftwaffe not RAF, and London want him just as urgently.

episodes.title: Day of Wrath
episodes.summary: ' Vengeance is Mine, saith the Lord'. But FI-Lt de Beers has other ideas, ideas which endanger his own people and ' Lifeline

episodes.title: The Last Run
episodes.summary: The Allied advance from the Invasion beaches is severing the evasion lines.Albert is forced to rethink his strategy, vengeance is brewing for the death of Max ... and Brandt's replacement turns out to be a formidable opponent.

episodes.title: Invasions
episodes.summary: Lifeline's principal safe house is ' blown' ... the threat to ' Lifeline ' and to the Chantal sisters is real and immediate.

episodes.title: Revenge
episodes.summary: The Communist vengeance takes form... and the ' Candide' prepares for siege tactics.

episodes.title: A Safe Place
episodes.summary: Albert is imprisoned. Monique takes charge of the line and is confronted with a second-time evader ... an air-ace with a mind of his own.

episodes.title: Ring of Rosies
episodes.summary: A one-in-a-million chance brings appalling sickness that threatens the extermination of ' Lifeline's ' personnel.

episodes.title: Prisoner
episodes.summary: London sends a tough and experienced officer to cope with the new situation. His first act is to make a deal with the Germans.

episodes.title: Ambush
episodes.summary: The V-weapons are the latest threat to the Allies. A convoy of ' rocket parts ' exposes Lifeline to sabotage action and Bradley makes his first mistake.

episodes.title: Just Light the Blue Touch-Paper
episodes.summary: The time has come for Bradley to use his ' private army' of evaders to act positively against the V2 weapons.

episodes.title: Sound of Thunder
episodes.summary: The Allies enter Belgium ... fear of reprisals for their ' collaboration ' begins to haunt Lifeline ... and Albert, in prison, can do nothing about it.

episodes.title: Collaborator
episodes.summary: The newly-released Albert is confronted by his old Communist enemies as a collaborator. Only the Allies can save him.... but they are still on the fringes of Brussels

episodes.title: Days of Judgement
episodes.summary: The liberation brings terror for Lifeline. Monique disappears... so does Kessler.

episodes.title: Bridgehead
episodes.summary: A new life opens for Monique .. a new identity for Kessler

episodes.title: The Execution
episodes.summary: Spring 1945. The Germans find time for their own retributions. Monique and Madeleine have to make the most important decisions of their lives ... the Second World War is over.
